snippet.title: Dreadbound - Roguelike Stealth Action
snippet.description:
Check out Dreabound on steam! Demo coming soon.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3994820/DreadBound/

Dreadbound is an atmospheric action roguelike with immersive sim elements.
Sneak or fight your way through a cursed city that changes every time you die. Use an array of magic powers that can help with combat and traversal.
Eat bugs. Try different weapons. Throw chairs and vases at your enemies.
Escape.
